1.

In heaven, in heaven, Where God our Father dwells, How glorious shall the bliss be, How inexpressibly great, There face to face We shall eternally, eternally God behold And Jesus Himself, the Lamb of God.

2.

In heaven, in heaven What brightness, high and pure! Not even the sun resembles it In its noonday splendour. The sun that never sets, But stands eternally unclouded, Is the Lord Jesus Christ.

3.

In heaven, in heaven No tears are seen; No death, no corruption Shall there ravage more. An eternal joy and glory And peace and incorruptibility From the Lord are given us.

4.

In heaven, in heaven A bliss Thou hast prepared, Which no ear has heard yet And no eye has seen; Yet now revealed it is To those who have the Lord dear, Our Lord Jesus Christ!
